test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Sitting at the computer I saw something large and dark fall past my ______ vision followed by a dull thwack.
solution: The correct answer is **"peripheral".** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • **"Peripheral"** vision refers to the ability to see objects and movement outside of the direct line of vision. • In the given sentence, the speaker saw something fall in their peripheral vision. • The word **"peripheral" **is an adjective that describes something situated on the edge or periphery of something else. (क्षेत्र विशेष के बाहरी सिरे से संबंधित; परिधीय, परिरेखीय) • **Example: ***The book contains a great deal of **peripheral**__ detail.* • So, the correct answer is **option 3**. **Correct sentence:** *Sitting at the computer I saw something large and dark fall past my __**peripheral**__ vision followed by a dull thwack.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **Central:** refers to the centre or main area of something. (मध्यवर्ती, केंद्रीय, सर्वाधिक महत्वपूर्ण; मुख्‍य) • **External:** refers to something outside or separate from oneself. (बाहरी हिस्‍से का, बाहर स्थित, बाह्य) • **Incidental:** refers to something that is secondary or minor in importance. (अपेक्षया अधिक महत्वपूर्ण वस्‍तु के अंश के रूप में घटित; आनुषंगिक) 1ca:T901, The correct answer is **Hoot**.
